title: Selector, which offers an AI platform that promises to simplify network monitoring, raised a $32M Series B led by AVP at a $375M valuation (Maria Deutscher/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Maria Deutscher / SiliconANGLE: Selector, which offers an AI platform that promises to simplify network monitoring, raised a $32M Series B led by AVP at a $375M valuation — Network observability provider Selector Software Inc. today announced that it has raised a $32 million funding round at a $375 million valuation.
